description: Main source file for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game application, including UI initialization, theme setup, game state management, and game logic implementation.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that applies theme and sets the home page for the app.

classes.name: TicTacToePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main game page of Tic Tac Toe.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for MyApp and TicTacToePage.

methods.name: _handleTap
methods.description: Processes user taps on the game board, updating game state.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Checks for a winner or draw condition in the game.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the game to initial state.

methods.name: _statusText
methods.description: Returns the current game status message.

methods.name: _statusColor
methods.description: Determines color based on game status.
